excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, short black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a light red tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, red shorts and black hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_5 kneels alongside a sunlit riverbank bluff, using a precision pick to work away soft grayish-white chalk matrix from the tightly arranged paddle bones of a Clidastes mosasaur. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
